definitions: A collaborative business arrangement between two or more parties that primarily leverages intellectual property, brand, or services rather than significant physical assets or capital.
A partnership designed to achieve specific business objectives with minimal investment in tangible assets, often focusing on shared expertise, market access, or technology.
examples: They formed an asset-light joint venture to develop new software.
The company's strategy included several asset-light joint ventures.
An asset-light joint venture can reduce upfront costs.
